limitations: Source notation, not an original performance or musical approval.
Tied durations are notated holds, not measured acoustic sustain; percussion/dead-note sounding duration is not established.
IOI runs are consecutive equal onset spacings, not learned musical grouping.
Written rests are voice-specific source flags. Uncovered intervals are the union-of-notated-holds complement, not inferred written rests.
Absent accent/dynamic marks do not establish performed accents/dynamics. Dynamics are literal marks, not propagated values.
Meter is reported only with explicit or inherited source signature evidence, never parser defaults.
Captured context only; no complete-song or call-response learning claim.
Histograms count attack members; simultaneous notes count separately. Tied continuation notation is retained separately.
